caption: Taylor Swift broke touring records while the name Taylor fell to its lowest count since 1983. #Taylor #NameData #AIVoice
pinned_comment: Can a superstar save a name?
story_thesis: Taylor peaked at 21,270 girls in 1993 and fell to 772 in 2025, its lowest since 1983, despite Taylor Swift's record-breaking tour.
script: Fame does not save a name. Taylor peaked at 21,270 American girls in 1993. The Eras Tour became the highest-grossing tour ever. In 2025: 772. Watch the curve ignore the pop star.
